task_scope: Complete original AQuA test split, in original source order.

budget.output: Unconstrained autoregressive JSON containing thought and choice, original strict parser.

restart: Complete block boundaries only. Every new process warms the explicitly listed disjoint development tasks. Block seed is native.seed + block_index + 1. Incomplete attempts remain excluded.
sampling_reproducibility: Fixed task identities, source order and per-block seeds. Sampled predictions need not be bitwise identical when dynamic microbatch arrival order differs.
task_adaptation: Existing AQuA single-reasoning computation, system prompt, question/options renderer and strict parser imported unchanged. Formal disjoint development warmup and atomic block resume replace the old whole-workload timing warmup.
comparison_class: Authored direct single-agent generative control, not a published agent baseline.
